verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, so remote human approval of agent decisions is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows no mobile or remote approval flow. The Slack/GitHub integration only brings tasks into kanban and posts completed responses back to the source thread. The Ledger serves local views and explicitly exposes no mutation API, so there is nothing that lets a PM approve decisions from a phone while agents keep running.
